*Sanidassanattika, Ajjhattārammaṇattika* (Patthana 17.33) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna*, the final book of the canonical Theravāda Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. As a leaf-level section of the collection, it investigates conditional relations by combining the triads of visibility (*sanidassana*) and internal mental objects (*ajjhattārammaṇa*) within the framework of Buddhist causal analysis [SuttaCentral].
There are no curated parallels or external translations reported for this specific section, and automated cross-language comparison records no significant matches in Chinese, Sanskrit, or Tibetan corpora [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus].
